correctness.rationale: Node labels are unordered partitions of six coordinates into triples and plane labels perfect matchings; a node lies on a plane when each matched pair crosses the triple. The resulting 10×15 incidence has each row sum 6, column sum 4, II^T=4I+2J, rank mod2 5 and an explicit determinant-64 maximal minor. Combined with the degree map to Z/4, these force Smith nontrivial factors (2,2,2,2,4). The mod2 node-indicator construction identifies Q/2Q as F2^6/<ones> with its natural S6 action; quotienting by permutation gives c(σ)-δ(σ) mod2 generators, while the preserved degree map forces exactly one order-4 factor. Independently built the incidence via matchings and obtained the exact same Smith invariants and determinant 64; the source verifier checks all 720 S6 actions and eleven Frobenius types. The result concerns incidence coinvariants, not geometric Picard/Brauer groups.
